An AdminCap object (0x38a7b38d...) is held by EOA/address 0xf67d0193e9cd65c3c8232dbfe0694eb9e14397326bdc362a4fe9d590984f5a12. AdminCap gates set_supply_limit, add_version, remove_module, and set_beneficiary — active admin privileges over mint supply.

controls.label: Virtue Money AdminCap holder
controls.evidence: At IOTA Rebased (confirmed via iota_getObject): AdminCap object 0x38a7b38d0f03338397d1c57f2cc2e3d7c5e3f6fe6887626aacc4cb4e8072c3f5 is owned by AddressOwner 0xf67d0193e9cd65c3c8232dbfe0694eb9e14397326bdc362a4fe9d590984f5a12 (version 591278735). Package 0xd3b63e...904f is Immutable (no upgrade). The admin module exposes no public entry functions but AdminCap gates vusd::set_supply_limit, add_version, remove_module, remove_version, and set_beneficiary. Whether this address is a single EOA or a multisig could not be determined on-chain.

review.evidence: IOTA Rebased GraphQL confirmed AdminCap (type 0xd3b63e...::admin::AdminCap) is held by address 0xf67d0193e9cd65c3c8232dbfe0694eb9e14397326bdc362a4fe9d590984f5a12 (AddressOwner). iota_getNormalizedMoveModulesByPackage revealed vusd module exposing set_supply_limit, add_version, remove_module, remove_version, set_beneficiary — all AdminCap-gated. Package owner type = Immutable (cannot be re-published). The AdminCap holder address owns no other enumerable objects, so it may be a multisig or single-keypair; cannot confirm threshold/type from chain state alone. Promotion judgment: the AdminCap holder address is confirmed on-chain; on Move-VM chains an address holder is EOA-equivalent (single-key vs k-of-n keypair custody is indistinguishable from chain state, matching the EVM EOA custody rule and the standard applied to BUCK and suiUSDe on Sui). All mint-capable surfaces (immutable branch contracts; parameter-only AdminCap) are confirmed. Economic cap reviewed 2026-07-20: the CDP branch cap is not a firm bound, because vusd::set_supply_limit is gated only by the AdminCap held at a single Move address with no timelock and no independent co-signer evidenced on chain. Under the v9 authoring contract a self-controlled, no-timelock raiseable cap is economically unbounded, so economicCapSemantics is recorded as unbounded rather than left encoding-derived. This supersedes the contract-encoding cap only; directMintAbility is unchanged.
